notes.title: A word on our philosophy
notes.content:
Hi, we wanted to first of all give a big thank you to everyone that has given us feedback on the game (both negative and positive!), its super fun to see people taking time to comment on something we've made!

We know the game has very limited content right now - we released with only the core mechanics because we didn't really expect so many people to try it out and we also think that every good game builds on the foundation of something strong. 

We enjoyed the base gameplay of our game a lot when we played it in the office but wanted to get a second opinion in case we just had a bad case of home blindness* (which is actually quite common when you're making a game).

We expected to get a few (2-3?) players that would give us feedback but here we are...

But this is great (for us, and in the end for the game and you as players) because we have gotten so much feedback and suggestions that it feels like we can keep creating content for a few years (with a steady stream of releases ofc) around this core! 

In the end, this is what WE think early access means - getting a really early product in the hands of the community and listening to their feedback to help shape the game.

If you want to chat with us or leave your suggestions on what we should focus on (we heard from you guys that friends games was more anticipated than we expected which is the reason we went all in to get that updated before the weekend for example) then please join our Discord! 

See you at : https://discord.gg/wqwtDCf

Cheers!
The Sweet Team



*When we no longer see the flaws (or strengths) in our homes, we reach a state that the Swedes call “home blind.”

notes.title: Friends games
notes.content:
Hi, just wanted to let you all know that we're listening to your feedback and working around the clock to make the game a more enjoyable experience for you.

We're currently focusing on trying the following two things added:

Friends games - be able to invite friends and start either a private game or make sure all of you join the same lobby.

Region select - we're using a third party service for net code, and they will currently automatically select the best region (lowest ping) for you to play on. We want to make it possible for you to change Region if you want to for any reason.

We'll keep you updated on how we progress on these features.

Also, we have heard feedback regarding hit detection and lag. We're looking into dedicated servers, we just didn't manage to get it up and running in time. 

Rest assured that we know how important it is with dedicated servers and it is important to us as well so it will be added in the future.

notes.title: So its finally available
notes.content:
So we finally have the game available for everyone to play and we're super excited! 

It was pretty damn cool to sit at work and jump into the game and suddenly find names we didnt recognize in our matches - we hope you enjoy it so far!

We're getting some reports (and we noticed ourselves) that sometimes you cant join games.

For now the solution if you try to start a game and it only says "Open" on all spots is to restart the game. We'll try to fix that one ASAP because its annoying as hell.

If you're having troubles with the game, or if you just want to hang out and chat with us the developers, please feel free to join our discord: https://discord.gg/TyqF9jv

We're usually there around the clock and we'll do our best to help you out with any troubles you might have. It will really help us out a lot with resolving issues players might have with the game so a big thank you in advance!
